reply.text:
Ouch, glad you got looked at. Two cracked vertebrae is one for your doctor, not me, and "I feel fine" isn't something I can go on. I won't build or start anything until they've cleared you to train, and I'd ask them exactly what's okay, since "light" can mean different things after a spinal injury.

The streak will keep. A few weeks off won't undo what you've built, and once you have the green light we pick it back up from that day, with whatever they've cleared. Send me their guidance then and I'll build around it.
